prompt_length: Python str.split whitespace token counts, as specified by the authoring protocol and minimum floor.
response_word_count: The existing harness core.word_count uses Unicode word-token matching, not str.split. Its regex is [^\W_]+(?:['’\-][^\W_]+)*. All mean_words summaries use this unchanged function.
character_count: Python len(response): Unicode code points in the exact response string.
limits: The word-token metric includes words/numbers in code, treats supported internal apostrophes/hyphens as part of a token, and does not linguistically segment Chinese. Neither length measure establishes comprehension.
clarification: Distinguish prompt whitespace counts from response word-token counts in publication. No response, score, constraint check, or numeric aggregate changed. A15 v6 is 306 harness word tokens and 320 whitespace tokens; both are below its 350-word constraint.
